Python + FastAPI / Uvicorn / ONNX Runtime CPU
Start camera + microphone; speech resets a 15-second silence deadline.

POST /detect with JPEG, rotation and request ID; about every 2 seconds while active.
One network request at a time; expired scans cancel pending recognition.
Validate request / scan / track and response age; map the face box back to the camera view.
Names and cues expire together; ambiguous or lost tracks clear personal information.
Name beside the face; up to 2 cue icons underneath. Unknown → no icons.
Bundled vector symbols + separate heart / dislike / warning corner markers.
Fictional demo likes, dislikes and allergies
No SQLite query per recognition request
Photos stay on laptop; startup enrollment
Use the accepted identity to retrieve up to 2 cue records; allergy cues have priority.
Unknown or no matching profile → an empty cue list.
Name + face box + similarity + cue codes and sentiments (prefer / dislike / allergy).
Icon images are already bundled on the glasses; no extra icon download.
